W.note: Subtle, well-built night-glass button with long asymmetric curves and good focus/reduced-motion, but the hover change is quiet and barely reads as ethereal.

X.note: Clear aurora blur-bloom sweeping across the gradient with soft overshoot and slow exhale; strong affordance, legible label, focus ring and reduced motion handled.

Y.note: Luminous rim, cloud glow and floating plate with slow release curves, pre-blurred composite-only layers, calm mode, reduced-motion and strong focus ring in a polished real-world form.

Z.note: Pastel iridescent glow with blurred bloom is the most visually ethereal, but the low-contrast pale button at rest has weaker affordance and the blurred rotating glow is costlier.
